We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Toolmaker – Moulding to join our team. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Experience with CAD/CAM software (desirable).
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
General Construction Induction Certificate (Blue/White Card)
Current Working at Heights and Confined Space tickets
Current valid Driver’s license

This role is ideal for professionals with strong mainframe testing experience who enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating with cross functional teams, and contributing to high impact banking initiatives.

Responsibilities
bullet icon
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to define testing scope, clarify requirements, and ensure alignment across teams.

bullet icon
Design comprehensive test cases for System Testing (ST) and System Integration Testing (SIT), ensuring full coverage of functional and technical requirements.

bullet icon
Prepare and manage test data for end to end scenarios across core banking modules.

bullet icon
Execute manual progression and regression testing across mainframe and distributed environments.

bullet icon
Analyse test results, identify defects, and work with development teams to drive timely resolution.

bullet icon
Validate mainframe interactions with distributed systems, including batch processes, DB2 queries, and JCL workflows.

bullet icon
Prepare detailed test documentation including test plans, execution logs, defect reports, and status updates.

bullet icon
Communicate testing progress, risks, and insights clearly to project managers and business stakeholders.

Skills
Must have

bullet icon
Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.

bullet icon
5+ years of Core Banking Mainframe testing experience, with strong hands on exposure to Lending and other core banking modules.

bullet icon
Mainframe testing expertise including JCL, DB2, batch processing, and online transactions.

bullet icon
Core Banking application knowledge across Loans, Deposits, CIS, or Umbrella.

bullet icon
Advanced proficiency in manual testing methodologies (ST, SIT)

bullet icon
Experience in test process management, governance, and quality standards.

bullet icon
Strong analytical and problem solving skills, especially in Mainframe environments.

bullet icon
Excellent communication skills and ability to work across multiple projects.

bullet icon
Solid understanding of the banking domain, especially lending.

bullet icon
Highly disciplined, organised, and self motivated.

Nice to have

bullet icon
Hogan Core Banking Experience

bullet icon
Automation testing exposure

bullet icon
Performance Testing knowledge
